name: Hospital da Luz (Luz Saude)
verdict: Operated by Luz Saude, a Fidelidade group company: Fidelidade keeps a controlling position after selling 40% to a Macquarie infrastructure fund (concluded 29 January 2026). Fidelidade itself is 84.9892% Fosun International (HKEX-listed) and 15% state-owned CGD as a strategic minority. Nothing found.
note: Rated during the Casa Pia research (issue #390): Hospital da Luz is on the front of Casa Pia's 2026-27 home kit. Chain: Hospital da Luz -> Luz Saude -> Fidelidade (control, 60% before the Macquarie sale; the sale announcement says Fidelidade keeps 'uma posição de controlo') -> Fosun International 84.9892% / CGD 15%. CGD is owned by the Portuguese State, but its Fidelidade stake is a strategic minority without control (roughly 12.75% effective in Luz Saude) - state ownership alone is not a tier (METHOD.md). The Macquarie side (MEIF 7 MED BIDCO, S.A., 40%) is a fund holding, no control. Fosun is a private-to-listed Hong Kong group, not a state body. Earlier percentages in this note (60/40 Sep 2025; 85/15) were unsourced and have been replaced by sourced figures.
